title: Dimension Follow
description: A mod that makes you teleport to a player that gets moved to another dimension. Works with modded dimensions like wonderland.jar!
body:
# Dimension Follow A Minecraft mod that makes you follow a player that gets teleported to another dimension. This mod is very useful for mods like `wonderland.jar` where your friend gets teleported to another dimension but you get left behind.

* [Modrinth page](https://modrinth.com/mod/dimension-follow) * [Curseforge page](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/dimension-follow) ## Config The mod let's you configure basically every part of the mod. You can use the `/dimensionfollow config` command to change the config at any time without restarting the server. ### Radius `/dimensionfollow config radius` Players within this many blocks of the teleporting player's old position will follow them to the new dimension. ### Teleport Whole World `/dimensionfollow config teleportWholeWorld` If true, every player in the teleporting player's old dimension follows instead of only players inside radius. ### Require Confirmation `/dimensionfollow config requireConfirmation` If true, players receive a clickable confirmation prompt before following a dimension teleport. ### Confirmation Timeout `/dimensionfollow config confirmationTimeoutSeconds` Seconds before a pending teleport confirmation expires. ### Ignored Dimensions `/dimensionfollow config ignoredDimensions add/remove/list` Dimensions that will not be followed. Should be a list of dimension IDs, e.g. "minecraft:overworld". ## Credits * [rotgruengelb](https://bsky.app/profile/rotgruengelb.bsky.social) - [Stonecutter Template](https://github.com/rotgruengelb/stonecutter-mod-template) * [wonderland.jar](https://modrinth.com/mod/wonderland-jar) - Made me think to make this mod * [Chutoy](https://x.com/chutoyjohn) - Tester * [Numberless](https://x.com/LeonardoZa92804) - Tester 2 ### Stonecutter Modern Gradle plugin for multi-version development, you can check out [Stonecutter here](https://stonecutter.kikugie.dev/).
This has tremendously sped up development and made maintaining multiple versions much easier.
